description: This Perl script analyzes and extracts information about target configurations, architectures, kernels, and devices in an OpenWRT build environment by invoking make commands and parsing their output.

methods.name: parse_targetinfo
methods.description: Parses target information by executing make with specific parameters and capturing target, architecture, kernel, and features data.

methods.name: parse_devices
methods.description: Parses device profiles and alternative device names from make output.

methods.name: get_targetinfo
methods.description: Iterates over target Makefiles to gather target, subtarget, and related info.

methods.name: get_devices
methods.description: Fetches device information for a specific target/subtarget.
